rulings.subject: GET /spine/anchor/verify/{atom_id}
rulings.ruling: REVERT the gating. Restore to anonymous, exactly as on origin/main, and remove its _GUARDED entry.
rulings.rationale: Public verifiability is load-bearing doctrine, not an oversight in the original code. _rd_disclosure_twin/02_cockpit_precedent.md states the expansion path as the Merkle-sealed log becoming the subscriber-facing proof surface, with attestations verifiable without trusting us. Verifiable without trusting us means reachable without our credential; gating it inverts the tamper-evidence claim the whole product rests on. The planner dispatch named the route and should not have.
rulings.principle: Gate what you SERVE, never what PROVES you. GET /spine/atom/{atom_id} serves content and stays gated; GET /spine/anchor/verify/{atom_id} proves content and must not be.
implementation: app/routers/spine.py: anchor_verify signature restored byte-for-byte to origin/main (atom_id plus db=Depends(get_db)); the get_user_or_service_caller dependency removed.
The principle is encoded as a DOCTRINE comment block immediately above the route, naming the guard test so nobody re-gates it later; the docstring says ANONYMOUS BY DESIGN.
tests/test_service_caller_auth.py: the anchor/verify entry removed from _GUARDED and replaced with a _PUBLIC_VERIFIER constant.
NEW test_anchor_verify_is_public -- prod-style auth (dev bypass OFF), no Authorization, no X-Dev-User, no service key, and the verifier still answers 200 with pass=false and reason=atom not found.

NEW test_anchor_verify_carries_no_auth_dependency -- structural: walks the route dependency graph and fails if ANY of the six auth dependencies reappears. Stronger than a status assertion, which a gate that still returned 200 for some caller could slip past.
NEW test_the_atom_serve_sibling_is_still_gated -- pins the other half of the distinction so the two routes cannot drift into one policy.
Route introspection now reports 5 guarded routes, not 6; the verifier's only dependency is get_db.
MUTATION E (re-gate the verifier) gives 2 failed, 26 passed. Both new anti-regression tests fire. Restored gives 28 passed.

rulings.subject: GET /positions/{symbol}/context
rulings.ruling: CONFIRMED -- keep it user-only, keep the pinning test.
rulings.rationale: It reads the caller's own theses and brokerage position, which is tenant-private and not instrument-keyed. Putting it behind one shared service secret would break the tenant-sovereignty rule in CLAUDE.md.
rulings.status: NO CHANGE NEEDED -- already built this way; test_position_context_stays_user_only retained.

rulings.subject: the rest of TW-24
rulings.ruling: The commit-to-the-service-path property, the require_operator refusal ordering ahead of the dev bypass, the reserved service: namespace, and the mutation-verification of each protection are all confirmed correct and unchanged.
